title: The Wounded Quarry
text: The quarry lies on its side in the bracken, breathing hard, an arrow that is not yours buried in its flank. Someone else has wounded it. Its eye rolls toward you, and it gathers its legs beneath it. It can still fight.

options.label: Finish it while it is down.

outcomes.text: It fights to the last, and the last is a long time coming.

options.label: The healer tends its wound instead.

outcomes.text: It lets them, trembling, and limps away. The hunt is over another way.

options.label: The sharpest eye finds who wounded it.

outcomes.text: A rival House's arrow, fletched in their colours.
